coordinates.policy: Site display is Three.js Y-up. Rhino Map-Z-to-glTF-Y is already in the file; do not swap axes again. Plan polygons store (x,z) in site feet. Lattice proto forms stay 20×20×20 ft and are not stretched to the property.

statements: Derive walls from real source edges and recomputed receiver intervals.
Preserve differences between direct contacts, recessed connections and intentional openings.
Print variants derive stepped contour floors, roof planks, partial returns and upper columns.
Keep mesh integrity separate from circulation and structural validation.

parameters.receiverContract: Approved direct walls end at receiver bottoms; print walls use their recorded top-edge rules.

provenance.rotationSeedNote: Saved output records 55 degrees but omits its rotation seed. Default 189 is a reconstructed seed producing 55 degrees through the unchanged native formula; not claimed as the original seed.

request.sourceName: Linear Edge Gallery · 55° compact upper form

B.contract: Consume this exact saved provenance.request, nativeMeshHash, poses, frame and geometryHash; never rerun Rule A.

limitations: Authentic rectangular organizing field fitted within polygon; this is not a free-form perimeter rule.
Rule A only. Building footprint coverage cannot be measured before Rule B.
Spacing means native course spacing, not an invented minimum gap between running-bond letters.
Only Linear Edge Gallery print-contour adaptive adapter implemented; other authentic definitions remain registered.
No U letters occur in this authentic variant.

adaptive.coveragePolicy: Spatial extent budgets the organizing field independently of the architectural coverage target. Building coverage is measured after Rule B.

development.planningDiameterMeaning: Feasibility disk diameter only; zero disables the extra screen in Generate Design. Existing Territory Studio positive-diameter validation is unchanged. Not a boundary setback
